note: Set A captures the title block and submission facts that Set B omits entirely: drawing date 08.22.2013, lot number #101, drawn by SCI-ARC / Caltech, checked by Daniel Lee, and the Design/Construction/As-Built submission dates. Both sets correctly bind the reference keynotes (22 33 00 tank, 23 56 01 pump station, 23 56 13.01 collectors), the plan scale, and the 1/2 in copper glycol-loop piping. Set A's only real error is a misread value '23 56 13.0' (truncated from 23 56 13.01) bound to a vague 'Solar Thermal System' entity; Set B has no clear misreads but duplicates keynote claims and adds a thinly supported 'reference designation' claim. The missing title-block and revision facts in B outweigh A's single misread.
